reserves.issuerOrObligor: Tetra Trust Company reserve trust and undisclosed Canadian banking counterparties

sources.label: Baker Tilly CADD reasonable-assurance report - April 2026

reserveReview.rationale: Baker Tilly's April 2026 reasonable-assurance report reconciles CAD 540,050 of CADD circulation to CAD 540,050 of reserve assets at April 30, classifies 100% of the reserve as Canadian-dollar cash, and states that the assets are held in segregated, unencumbered trust accounts. Tetra's July 13 daily report later self-reports the same 100% cash class, without superseding the independent assurance date.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Pinned Baker Tilly assets-and-liabilities reasonable-assurance report
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The independently assured reserve class and liability reconciliation are complete at April 30; individual reserve-bank identities and account allocations remain undisclosed.
